_comment: Round 38 (D2-7): every decision NOT to take an update, with a date to re-decide it by.
Read by .github/scripts/dependency-holds.py in CI (ci-scripts) and weekly (pinned-tools.yml).
A Dependabot `ignore` (.github/dependabot.yml) hides every later major; an npm `overrides` entry
forces one version and hides every later one. Each must be listed here with the same value, a
reason and a review_by date no more than max_days after `since`; a passed date fails CI until the
hold is re-decided (take the update, or re-check and move both dates). `since` is when the hold was
recorded here, not a claim that it was re-reviewed then. Same review date as the npm-audit
allowlists' entries (2027-01-20), which these holds mostly explain.
